limitations: Scripted policies are deterministic probes, not human playtests or guarantees about player outcomes. Round duration is provisional.
Both levels replay identical recorded incoming arrivals, categories and sizes. Choices and dependency outcomes can differ.
Fixed-horizon metrics freeze after an earlier ending and report alive=false.
All workers automatically work when usable capacity exists; scripted transfer policies cannot choose to leave workers idle.

Single-column completion ceilings use up to the per-column worker cap, exclude other concurrent columns, and assume uninterrupted fresh tasks and omit reaction time, unattended decay, dependencies, and admission delays.

averagePending and averageWork use approximate left-endpoint time integrals. WIP/backlog/satisfaction peaks and unlock times are sampled at decision boundaries. Final and fixed-horizon counts are exact.
